title: 第21章 憧憬未来第22章 无神论者
slug: 给你玉女心经没让你用双修证道
content_zh:
“我也不知道那个功法会演变成什么样，我们现在也没别的办法，只能继续练下去。”
“至少现在看还不错，虽然事后我有一段时间会昏迷不醒，但我们的进步速度都很快。”
“我感觉这功法很邪门，可以快速提升实力，应该算一种邪道功法。”
“我们对外界的情况不了解，在我的认知里，修炼邪道功法遭人恨的，所以你们千万不能泄露出去。”
“我们知道了。”两人异口同声道。
“好了，先去准备吃的吧，这几天吃甜点，我都快吃吐了！”
“啊，少爷是害怕我下药，才一直不敢吃东西吧！”月儿恍然大悟道。
“你说呢！”黄夜瞪了月儿一眼。
“奴婢知错了，一会儿一定给您准备好吃的，这回您不用担心了。”
“少爷，奴婢想看看您走路的样子。”
“这有什么好看的。”
虽然嘴里这么说，黄夜还是下床走了两步。
“少爷，您好帅！”月儿由衷地说道。
“有么？”黄夜下意识摸摸脸，前世他只是个普通人，跟帅一点不沾边。
没想到穿越过来，还弄了一副好皮囊。
“嗯，您比二少爷强百倍，我见到二少爷根本不敢抬头，他长得太吓人。”
“我看他还行啊。”
“您看他还行，因为您是男的，我们婢女都怕他，他看我们的眼神很邪恶。”
“没错，我跟侍卫学武也是防着他。”晴儿赞同地说道。
“这倒是，我看他的眼神也很邪恶，你们尽量隐藏自己。”

“晴儿，隐藏的方法你也告诉月儿。”
“其实以你们现在的实力，能轻松收拾他，麻烦的是他的几个跟班。”
“那天我看到那几个跟班的实力都不弱，他身边的人至少也是武师级别。”
“在我们没有强大前，尽量躲着他，不给他机会。”
“尤其是月儿，你刚进入府中，没有人罩着你，他对你下手没什么顾忌。”
“知道了，我会躲着他。”
“你们争取弄到府中的地形图，摸清侍卫的巡逻时间和路线。”
“少爷，地形图我大致能画出来，侍卫的巡逻情况我看能不能从侍卫那里打听到。”
“你要小心些，千万别问，多注意观察，能知道多少是多少。”
“少爷，我会注意的。”
“好了，暂时这么安排，月儿先回去，晚上多弄点好吃的过来。”
“是，少爷！”月儿轻轻一福，转身离开房间。
“少爷，月儿值得相信么？用不用我去监视她？”
“不用，她很聪明，知道趋利避害，她的江湖经验要比你丰富。”
“少爷，我跟她差不多年纪，她一直生活在贫穷的环境，不会比我强吧。”
“就是因为贫穷，她才更懂得保护自己。从看她分析自己的状况就能看出来。”
“好了，不用担心她，上床，我们修炼功法。”
“啊！少爷，天还没黑呢。”
“我想试试第二次会不会有第一次的效果，功法我们都不熟悉，需要经常练习。”
“好吧！”…………。

一个时辰后，月儿提着食盒回来了。
刚到门口便停住脚步，里面传来羞羞的声音，让她没敢推门。
等了一会儿，声音一直不断，身上不由自主传来燥热的感觉。
content_en:
"I don't know how that skill will evolve. We have no other choice now but to continue practicing."
"At least it looks good now. Although I will be unconscious for a while afterwards, we are making rapid progress."
"I feel that this technique is very evil. It can quickly improve your strength. It should be considered an evil technique."
"We don't know the situation in the outside world. From my understanding, people who practice evil techniques are hated, so you must not let it out."
"We get it." The two said in unison.
"Okay, let's go prepare food first. I almost vomit after eating desserts these days!"
"Ah, the young master must be afraid that I will drug him, so he never dares to eat!" Yue'er suddenly realized.
"What do you think?" Huang Ye glared at Yue'er.
"I realize my mistake. I will prepare delicious food for you soon. You don't have to worry this time."
"Master, I want to see how you walk."
"What's so interesting about this."
Despite what he said, Huang Ye still got out of bed and took two steps.
"Master, you are so handsome!" Yue'er said sincerely.
"Really?" Huang Ye subconsciously touched his face. In his previous life, he was just an ordinary person, not handsome at all.
Unexpectedly, I traveled through time and got a good skin.
"Well, you are a hundred times better than the second young master. I don't dare to raise my head when I see the second young master. He looks too scary."
"I think he's okay."
"It's okay for you to look at him, because you are a man, and we maids are afraid of him. He looks at us very evilly."
"That's right, I learned martial arts from the guards to guard against him." Qing'er said in agreement.
"That's true. I also look at him with evil eyes. You try to hide yourselves."
"Qing'er, tell Yue'er how to hide it."
"Actually, with your current strength, you can easily deal with him. The trouble is with a few of his followers."
"That day I saw that those followers were not weak in strength, and the people around him were at least at the level of martial arts masters."
"Before we are strong, try to avoid him and not give him a chance."
"Especially Yue'er, you just entered the house and there is no one to protect you. He has no scruples about attacking you."
"I know, I will avoid him."
"You try to get the topographic map of the mansion and find out the patrol time and route of the guards."
"Master, I can roughly draw the terrain map. I'll see if I can find out from the guards about their patrol status."
"You have to be careful. Don't ask. Pay more attention and observe more. You will know as much as you can."
"Master, I will pay attention."
"Okay, this is the arrangement for the time being. Yue'er will go back first and bring over some delicious food in the evening."
"Yes, Master!" Yue'er said lightly, turned and left the room.
"Master, is Yue'er trustworthy? Do you need me to monitor her?"
"No need, she is very smart and knows how to seek advantages and avoid disadvantages. She has more experience in the world than you."
"Master, I'm about the same age as her. She has been living in a poor environment. She can't be better than me."
"It is because of poverty that she knows how to protect herself. You can see it by watching her analyze her own situation."
"Okay, don't worry about her, go to bed, and let's practice our skills."
"Ah! Master, it's not dark yet."
"I want to try to see if the second time will have the same effect as the first time. We are not familiar with the technique and need to practice it regularly."
"Okay!"………….
An hour later, Yue'er came back with a food box.
She stopped as soon as she reached the door. A shy voice came from inside, so she didn't dare to open the door.
After waiting for a while, the sound continued, and a hot feeling came over my body involuntarily.
